_comment: Example Claude Code settings (~/.claude/settings.json or .claude/settings.json) wiring ethos-gate through the single combined hook.
_notes: Replace /path/to/ethos-gate with the folder you cloned.
basic_hook.py does nothing unless HARNESS_VERIFY=1 is set. With it set, it runs the credential gate, the test-before-irreversible gate and the GitHub gate, and the first deny wins.
Set ETHOS_AUTONOMOUS=1 for unattended sessions to turn on the stricter credential tier.
ETHOS_OWNED_ORGS is a comma-separated list of GitHub org or user names you own. Actions against these skip the external-action check.
ETHOS_PROD_PATH_PATTERN is an optional regex. If set, touching a matching path means Stop is blocked until a done-gate script has run.
Hook timeouts are in seconds. A hook that times out lets the command through (exit 0) by design.
